outcome: SCR-03 Decision desk on the live API: read the invoice or accounting review, claim it, record approve, return or reject
acceptance_criteria: Open `/work/17/decide?task=41` against the mock or live server as a person who can claim. The page makes `GET /tasks/41`, one `POST /tasks/41/claim` with `{expected_revision:3}`, and shows the label, version, formatted amount and recipient — verify: network log in `tests/decide.test.tsx` (one claim call, even under StrictMode) and the page text.

No evidence is pre-selected and approve, return and reject are disabled until one item of `review_evidence` is chosen — verify: test asserts disabled buttons on open, enabled after choosing, and the decision body carries that item's `id`.

Approve sends exactly `{expected_revision, verdict:"approve", evidence_id, note}` with `note` present even when empty; return and reject with an empty note show a validation message and send nothing — verify: request-body assertions in the test.

A decision 200 shows the done board with the verdict, note and label, and does not show "decided by" unless the history read has a matching item (then actor and time from it) — verify: test with and without a history item.

A 409 on claim or decision reloads and shows the stale board with the replaced version beside the current one, controls on the current only after "Review version n"; the write is not resent — verify: test counts decision calls (1).

A network or 5xx failure on the decision reloads once, never resends, and shows the uncertain notice; when the reload also fails, the buttons stay disabled and Try again only issues GETs — verify: test.

Wrong user: `can_decide:false, can_claim:false` shows the read-only board with no decision controls and no specific reason sentence; no claim is sent — verify: test; wrong tenant or unknown task: GET 404 shows the no-access state; 401 shows signed-out; 403 on a write turns the page read-only — verify: tests per status.
Invalid input: a 422 on the decision shows the server message (and `fields[]` text) without leaving the board and without clearing the picked evidence or note — verify: test.
Unknown amount (`invoice_packet:null` or empty) shows "Unknown", never 0 or "₦0.00" — verify: test on `formatAmount` and the page.

A task whose `verdicts[]` omits a verdict does not draw that button; no revoke control exists on SCR-03 or `InlineDecide` — verify: `grep -rn "revoke" src/features/decide src/features/workspace/InlineDecide.tsx` returns nothing, plus a test.
No pager "decision n of m" is drawn unless `GET /work?queue=decisions` succeeds and contains this task; with the list failing the rest of the page still works — verify: test both cases.
Comment on the not-yours board (if kept, Question 4) sends `{revision, body}`, requires a body, shows the server message on 403/409/422 and does not send twice — verify: test.

Every call on this feature goes through `liveApi` and the typed live schema; `tests/api-live-schema-drift.test.ts` still passes — verify: `grep -rn "api\.\(GET\|POST\)" src/features/decide` returns nothing.

The page matches the approved boards at 1440 and 390 for default, done, not-yours and stale, apart from the parts listed under Questions — verify: UI review of the changed area; the own board is checked only for the unreachable-state note below.

risk.rationale: Medium. The change is one screen, but it sits on a contract change: required evidence and note, no revoke, and reshaped task reads. It also writes a business decision (approval of an invoice or accounting review) with revision-conflict handling. Several design parts are removed because the live API cannot fill them, so the client must accept the result as a changed flow (product-decision). No data or migration work is involved, and the backend is not touched. Verification is contained: five boards and a mockable API.

completion.reason: Project, readiness, implementation and review evidence has not been supplied.
